arrays.name: Q
arrays.procedure: standard_normal((8, 3)); reduced QR; columns signed so diag(R) > 0

arrays.name: Q2
arrays.procedure: standard_normal((8, 2)); reduced QR; columns signed so diag(R) > 0

arrays.name: O6_directions
arrays.procedure: standard_normal((16, 8)); each row divided by its Euclidean norm; signs applied later as +v then -v

arrays.name: O4_directions
arrays.procedure: standard_normal((64, 3)); each row divided by its Euclidean norm; signs applied later as +v then -v

arrays.name: O7_directions
arrays.procedure: shared with O6_directions; no second draw
